extraction_notes: Filing is materially THIN on named Pentagon Program Elements or specific DoD program titles. ATI is a specialty-materials supplier (titanium/nickel alloys); they sell to OEM primes (GE Aviation, Pratt & Whitney, Rolls-Royce, Boeing) rather than direct-to-Pentagon on named PEs. Defense exposure is described in aggregate categories ('naval nuclear products, military jet engines, fixed wing and rotorcraft products, armor applications') without naming specific PE numbers, programs of record, or revenue concentration by program. This is the prototypical 'no specific J-Book hooks' filing — Mode A claim verification yields mostly UNVERIFIABLE; the framework should mostly downscore claims to PASS/UNVERIFIABLE rather than flag.
